text:
incident-bot: [P1] Routing tail latency spike detected in eu-west-2 for streaming endpoints. p95 ~ 800ms, p99 > 10s, several customers impacted. Auto-page oncall. Dash: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/alerts/2187654321 :rotating_light:

maya: oncall acknowledged, joining. seeing repeated tail spikes and stream stalls since 03:12 UTC. correlates with router pool rtr-ew2-2.

chris: same. looks like misrouting after last routing-policy rollout. lots of keys concentrated on a few shards -> hot partitioning + queueing. logs show 502s and stream timeouts.

drew: quick check: router queue length up and backlog on event loop. p99 requests show long wait_for_worker times.

sara: customers flagged: corpA (realtime chat), corpB (live transcription). corpA p50 ok, p99 ~12s, errors 502 and streaming stalls. They already reached out.

nick-oncall: i'm taking the page. first action: confirm rollout timestamp and consider immediate rollback or emergency override. @chris when was the routing policy pushed?

chris: routing-policy v3.7.1 rolled at 03:14 UTC (canary -> gradual). weight decay math mis-applied for affinity=hot keys, effectively giving one shard 4x weight.

maya: mitigation idea: disable eager-fallback and push an override to route new sessions to rtr-ew2-burst pool while we rebalance. that should reduce tail.

drew: also bump worker in-flight limit to reduce queueing. will coordinate if we need to restart workers.

maya: command to push override:
```
redwoodctl routing override --region eu-west-2 --target rtr-ew2-burst --reason "mitigate tail latency" --ttl 900
```

ops-bot: Override request accepted. Executed by nick-oncall; override id ov-8721 applied to 6 routers in eu-west-2. TTL=15m.

ev an: quick metric after override: p99 dropped from ~11s -> ~1.2s within 90s, errors down 70%. tail still shows occasional multi-second stalls for long-lived streams.

chris: logs indicate many streaming sessions had KV cache pinned to old shard; when we re-route traffic sessions still try to hit old shard causing proxy stalls. need a graceful KV handoff or session proxying.

drew: plan: (1) rewarm KV prefixes on new pool, (2) run temporary shard-proxy for live sessions to forward to original shard until migrated, (3) then fully cut over.

maya: can we do a sticky migrate flag for active sessions? that would keep active sessions on original shard while new sessions go to burst pool.

chris: yes, can set cookie header routing: `sticky_migrate=true` for active session keys. will coordinate with infra.

sara: drafting status page: "We are investigating increased latency for streaming endpoints in eu-west-2. Mitigations underway. A subset of customers may experience degraded streaming performance. Next update in 15m."

maya: running runbook checks: router heap sizes, per-worker queue length, active streams. worker rtr-ew2-2-07 has 98% CPU and ~12k active streams -> heavy backpressure.

nick-oncall: i'm going to drain and restart that router instance gracefully. sequence: drain -> wait for active sessions to drop -> restart -> rejoin.

# drain command
```
redwoodctl router drain rtr-ew2-2-07 --timeout 300 && redwoodctl router restart rtr-ew2-2-07 --graceful
```

ops-bot: Drain started on rtr-ew2-2-07 by nick-oncall. active streams: 12,000 -> 1,400 after 35s.

evan: after restart p99 ~850ms, p95 ~180ms. override still active. stream stalls much reduced. monitoring shows no error surge.

chris: root cause summary so far: regression in routing-policy weight decay logic caused hot-key concentration -> hot partitioning -> worker overload -> streaming stalls. rollback of policy + override + router restarts mitigated.

drew: opened mitigation tickets: rewarm job queued, patch for sticky proxy, and follow-up to tune worker capacity for streaming bursts.

sara: status page published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2187654321 - customer comms sent to corpA support contacts.

maya: owners for follow-up postmortem: chris (root cause + patch), drew (migration + rewarm), sara (customer comms). we'll keep monitoring 60m then resolve page if stable.

nick-oncall: handing active monitoring to evan for next 60m. i'm available if it regresses. :thumbsup:

ev an: ack. watchers on dashboards and traces. will escalate if p99 exceeds 2s again.

incident-bot: Page status -> mitigated (monitoring), page severity lowered to P2 at 03:42 UTC.

maya: filing postmortem stub now, keeping logs and timeline. good work team.

sara: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and the postmortem post. :heart:
